annotations.title: Julian day, sidereal time, Delta T and time scales

description: Julian day, modified Julian day, sidereal time (Greenwich and local, mean and apparent), Delta T, TAI-UTC and UT1-UTC for a moment. E.g. {datetime: '2026-06-21T12:00:00Z', longitude: 2.35, latitude: 48.86}. For telescope control, data reduction and education: the Julian day in UTC, UT1, TT and TDB, the modified Julian day, Julian centuries since J2000 (TT), Delta T (TT - UT1), TAI - UTC and UT1 - UTC, Greenwich mean and apparent sidereal time and, with a longitude, the local ones; plus day of year and ISO week. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.01 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/astronomy/time (x402 or MPP); each client gets 1 free call on the $0.01-0.02 tools, this one included.

datetime.description: The moment: UTC ('2026-06-21T12:00:00Z'), with an explicit offset, or local civil time with latitude/longitude.

latitude.description: Optional: resolve a local time, and give the local sidereal time.

timezone.description: IANA zone for local times, e.g. 'Europe/Paris'. Optional: resolved from the coordinates (with its historical DST rules).

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.
